if(!defined('DATALIFEENGINE')) {
    die("Hacking attempt!");
}

global $db, $config, $row;

// Sezon ID'sini al
$season_id = $row['id'];

// Bölümleri sorgula
$result = $db->query("SELECT p.id, p.title, p.alt_name, p.xfields, p.date 
    FROM " . PREFIX . "_post p 
    WHERE p.approve=1 
    AND p.xfields LIKE '%type|episode%' 
    AND p.xfields LIKE '%season_id|{$season_id}%' 
    ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.xfields, 'episode_number|', -1), '||', 1) AS SIGNED) ASC");

// Template verilerini hazırla
$episodes_data = array();
while($episode = $db->get_row($result)) {
    $xfields = xfieldsdataload($episode['xfields']);
    $episode_data = array(
        'id' => $episode['id'],
        'title' => $episode['title'],
        'alt_name' => $episode['alt_name'],
        'link' => $config['http_home_url'] . $episode['id'] . '-' . $episode['alt_name'] . '.html',
        'date' => $episode['date'],
        'episode_number' => isset($xfields['episode_number']) ? $xfields['episode_number'] : '',
        'episode_image' => isset($xfields['episode_image']) ? $xfields['episode_image'] : '',
        'episode_image_url' => isset($xfields['episode_image_url']) ? $xfields['episode_image_url'] : ''
    );
    $episodes_data[] = $episode_data;
}

// Template'i yükle ve verileri gönder
$tpl->load_template('episodes_list.tpl');

foreach($episodes_data as $episode) {
    foreach($episode as $key => $value) {
        $tpl->set('{'.$key.'}', $value);
        if($value) {
            $tpl->set("[xfgiven_{$key}]", "");
            $tpl->set("[/xfgiven_{$key}]", "");
            $tpl->set("[xfvalue_{$key}]", $value);
        } else {
            $tpl->set_block("'\\[xfgiven_{$key}\\](.*?)\\[/xfgiven_{$key}\\]'si", "");
        }
    }
    
    // [row] tagları için
    $tpl->set('[row]', '');
    $tpl->set('[/row]', '');
    
    $tpl->compile('episodes');
}

// Çıktıyı göster
echo $tpl->result['episodes'];
?>

if(!defined('DATALIFEENGINE')) {
    header( "HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden" );
    header ( 'Location: ../../' );
    die( "Hacking attempt!" );
}

if($member_id['user_group'] != 1) {
    die(json_encode(['error' => 'Yetkisiz erişim!']));
}

$action = $_POST['action'] ?? $_GET['action'] ?? '';

switch($action) {
    case 'delete':
        $id = intval($_POST['id']);
        if($id > 0) {
            $db->query("DELETE FROM " . PREFIX . "_post WHERE id = '$id'");
            clear_cache();
            die(json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'İçerik başarıyla silindi']));
        }
        die(json_encode(['error' => 'Geçersiz ID']));
        break;
        
    case 'generate_meta':
        // Boş meta açıklamaları güncelle
        $db->query("UPDATE " . PREFIX . "_post SET metatitle = title WHERE metatitle = ''");
        die(json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Meta açıklamaları güncellendi']));
        break;
        
    case 'clear_cache':
        clear_cache();
        die(json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Önbellek temizlendi']));
        break;
        
    case 'optimize_db':
        // Veritabanı tablolarını optimize et
        $tables = $db->query("SHOW TABLES LIKE '" . PREFIX . "_%'");
        while($table = $db->get_row($tables)) {
            $table_name = array_values(get_object_vars($table))[0];
            $db->query("OPTIMIZE TABLE " . $table_name);
        }
        die(json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Veritabanı optimize edildi']));
        break;
        
    case 'check_links':
        // Kırık linkleri kontrol et
        $broken_links = array();
        $result = $db->query("SELECT id, title, xfields FROM " . PREFIX . "_post WHERE xfields LIKE '%type|%'");
        
        while($row = $db->get_row($result)) {
            if(preg_match_all('/http[s]?:\/\/(?:[a-zA-Z]|[0-9]|[$-_@.&+]|[!*\(\),]|(?:%[0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]))+/', $row['xfields'], $matches)) {
                foreach($matches[0] as $url) {
                    $headers = get_headers($url);
                    if(!$headers || strpos($headers[0], '200') === false) {
                        $broken_links[] = array(
                            'id' => $row['id'],
                            'title' => $row['title'],
                            'url' => $url
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        die(json_encode(['success' => true, 'broken_links' => $broken_links]));
        break;
        
    case 'get_weekly_stats':
        $stats = array();
        $dates = array();
        $series_counts = array();
        $season_counts = array();
        $episode_counts = array();
        
        // Son 7 günün verilerini al
        for($i = 6; $i >= 0; $i--) {
            $date = date('Y-m-d', strtotime("-$i days"));
            $start = strtotime($date . ' 00:00:00');
            $end = strtotime($date . ' 23:59:59');
            
            // Her içerik türü için ayrı sayım yap
            $count = $db->super_query("SELECT 
                COUNT(CASE WHEN xfields NOT LIKE '%type|%' THEN 1 END) as series,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN xfields LIKE '%type|season%' THEN 1 END) as seasons,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN xfields LIKE '%type|episode%' THEN 1 END) as episodes
            FROM " . PREFIX . "_post 
            WHERE date BETWEEN '$start' AND '$end'");
            
            $dates[] = date('d.m.Y', $start);
            $series_counts[] = intval($count['series']);
            $season_counts[] = intval($count['seasons']);
            $episode_counts[] = intval($count['episodes']);
        }
        
        die(json_encode([
            'success' => true,
            'dates' => $dates,
            'series' => $series_counts,
            'seasons' => $season_counts,
            'episodes' => $episode_counts
        ]));
        break;
        
    case 'generate_sitemap':
        // Site haritası oluştur
        $sitemap = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>' . PHP_EOL;
        $sitemap .= '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">' . PHP_EOL;
        
        $result = $db->query("SELECT id, date, alt_name FROM " . PREFIX . "_post WHERE approve=1");
        
        while($row = $db->get_row($result)) {
            $link = $config['http_home_url'] . date('Y/m/d/', $row['date']) . $row['alt_name'] . '.html';
            $date = date('Y-m-d', $row['date']);
            
            $sitemap .= "\t<url>" . PHP_EOL;
            $sitemap .= "\t\t<loc>$link</loc>" . PHP_EOL;
            $sitemap .= "\t\t<lastmod>$date</lastmod>" . PHP_EOL;
            $sitemap .= "\t\t<changefreq>weekly</changefreq>" . PHP_EOL;
            $sitemap .= "\t\t<priority>0.8</priority>" . PHP_EOL;
            $sitemap .= "\t</url>" . PHP_EOL;
        }
        
        $sitemap .= '</urlset>';
        
        $file = ROOT_DIR . '/sitemap.xml';
        file_put_contents($file, $sitemap);
        
        die(json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Site haritası başarıyla oluşturuldu']));
        break;
        
    case 'update_slugs':
        // SEF URL'leri güncelle
        $result = $db->query("SELECT id, title FROM " . PREFIX . "_post WHERE alt_name = ''");
        
        while($row = $db->get_row($result)) {
            $alt_name = totranslit($row['title'], true, false);
            $db->query("UPDATE " . PREFIX . "_post SET alt_name = '$alt_name' WHERE id = '{$row['id']}'");
        }
        
        die(json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'SEF URL\'ler güncellendi']));
        break;
        
    default:
        die(json_encode(['error' => 'Geçersiz işlem']));
}

<?php
if(!defined('DATALIFEENGINE')) die("Access denied!");

class TMDBHelper {
    private $api_key;
    private $language;
    private $base_url = "https://api.themoviedb.org/3";
    private $image_base_url = "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/";
    private $db;
    
    public function __construct() {
        global $db;
        $this->db = $db;
        
        // TMDB config tablosunu kontrol et ve oluştur
        $this->checkAndCreateTable();
        
        // Ayarları al
        $config = $this->db->super_query("SELECT * FROM `" . PREFIX . "_tmdb_config` LIMIT 1");
        
        if($config) {
            $this->api_key = $config['tmdb_api_key'];
            $this->language = $config['tmdb_language'];
        } else {
            $this->api_key = '';
            $this->language = 'tr-TR';
        }
    }
    
    private function checkAndCreateTable() {
        $table_exists = $this->db->super_query("SHOW TABLES LIKE '" . PREFIX . "_tmdb_config'");
        
        if(!$table_exists) {
            $this->db->query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `" . PREFIX . "_tmdb_config` (
                `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
                `tmdb_api_key` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                `tmdb_language` varchar(5) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tr-TR',
                `last_update` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
            ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci");
            
            $this->db->query("INSERT INTO `" . PREFIX . "_tmdb_config` 
                (`tmdb_api_key`, `tmdb_language`) VALUES ('', 'tr-TR')");
        }
    }
    
    public function searchTVShow($query) {
        if(empty($this->api_key)) {
            return array('error' => true, 'message' => 'API anahtarı bulunamadı');
        }
        
        $params = array(
            'api_key' => $this->api_key,
            'language' => $this->language,
            'query' => urlencode($query)
        );
        
        return $this->makeRequest("/search/tv", $params);
    }
    
    private function makeRequest($endpoint, $params = array()) {
        $url = $this->base_url . $endpoint . '?' . http_build_query($params);
        
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt_array($ch, array(
            CURLOPT_URL => $url,
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_HEADER => false,
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => false,
            CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT => 15,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 15,
            CURLOPT_USERAGENT => 'DLE TMDB Bot'
        ));
        
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpcode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        
        if(curl_errno($ch)) {
            curl_close($ch);
            return array(
                'error' => true,
                'message' => 'CURL Hatası: ' . curl_error($ch)
            );
        }
        
        curl_close($ch);
        
        if($httpcode != 200) {
            return array(
                'error' => true,
                'message' => 'TMDB API Hatası: ' . $httpcode
            );
        }
        
        return json_decode($response, true);
    }
}
